[SWS_ComM_00926]
Upstream requirements: SRS_ModeMgm_09243
⌈The PNC main state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION shall be the default PNC state
from power off.⌋
The main state COMM_PNC_NO_COMMUNICATION is the target state as long as the
PNC is neither requested ECU internally nor requested externally.
